balls.text: he backs away a mile outside leg, and slices it tamely to backward point
mistimes a slog on the leg side
Jakati misses the slog to a slower one
works a full delivery to deep midwicket
goes for the yorker, he backs away outside leg, and squeezes it out to third man
behind point for a single
inside edge towards short fine leg, Sachin throws to the non-striker's end, batsman is in though
low full toss, he hits it hard past the bowler, long on cuts it off
almost chopped on to the stumps, it goes just past them on the leg side
punched towards short third man
mistimes the lofted stroke down to long on

Jadeja has contrived to bowl himself, he has backed away to try and slog it through midwicket, been completely beaten for pace, the ball was onto him very quickly, and he only managed to drag it onto his stumps
neatly done, opens the face and squeezes the full delivery past point
tries to slog this full delivery away, hits it into the ground, it goes straight to Malinga
goes for the yorker, not full enough, worked to midwicket, batsman has to get back quickly
beaten with one that carries across him with the angle

Ashwin manages to run himself out in attempting a second run, slowish length ball on off stump, worked behind square leg, it is Harbhajan Singh who charges after it, slides, stops it, and rips the throw to Karthik, Ashwin is gone by a long way, Harbhajan celebrates
comes out and bashes the length ball away to sweeper cover
and again, wider this time, Ashwin bends his knees and goes for the steer, beaten
tries to hang in the crease and dab it to third man, misses
pushed past a diving extra cover
whipped through square leg
straight to midwicket, CSK have been finding the fielders with precision today, a forcing whip to a full delivery, but he found Harbhajan who took a sharp low catch
worked towards square leg
tucked behind square leg
punched off the back foot to sweeper cover
worked in front of square leg
full delivery pushed to midwicket

massive strike, Badri makes room and guides it behind point, there is an appeal for a run-out, and even the swift Dhoni, at full-stretch too, is caught short of his ground as Karthik takes the bails off

slower one, well bowled, he gets down on a knee and squeezes it to Harbhajan, who is to the right of Sachin at short third man, Harbhajan had three men behind point for Yusuf Pathan recently in the Mushtaq Ali final
comes walking down the track, takes it on the full and tucks it to deep midwicket
Karthik has done well to save four byes, Pollard's bouncer had too much height on it, and Karthik is not exactly tall, needed a big leap to glove it down
was thinking of making some room, Pollard bowled it full at the stumps, Badri squeezes it out
widish one crashed away to sweeper cover
stays back in the crease and forces it to extra cover
slower through the air, dipping on Badri who comes forward and blocks
squeezes out another single with a push to extra cover
full ball gracefully driven down to long off
goes deep in the crease to work it down to wide long on
pushes well forward to keep this tossed up ball out
pushed off the front foot wide of cover for one
worked through square leg from the crease
wide ball cut hard straight to point
another wicket, it is Pragyan Ojha again who is involved, he is at deep square leg, and Albie has swung a length ball off his pads straight to him
pushed away to point
they take half the run before the ball passes a diving backward point, and the other half after it has passed him
driven straight to mid off, non-striker has to get back quickly
dabbed away to short third man
worked through square leg
driven off the front foot to sweeper cover
nudged towards vacant short fine off the pad, Karthik goes after it
Bravo tees off to one tossed up on leg, and finds Pollard at long on, did not time it well in the end, at least not as well as he executed the golf swing, that was picture perfect
misses the dab towards third man
pushed down to long on
now a slower one, Albie is already forward and pushes in the air to long off
out of nowhere, Pollard digs in a pretty sharp and nasty bouncer, Albie is surprised, belatedly tries to hook it, cannot connect
Rohit has a go at the stumps from behind point and instead hits Albie on the leg
puts front foot out and slams this full one wide of mid off
short, sitting up, and wide down leg, Albie tries to swing it fine, misses
punched to cover
half an appeal for caught behind, seemed to have gone off the pad
Raina charges out, Ojha goes wide outside off, Raina reaches out and drives in the air, picks out sweeper cover, Ojha jumps, and celebrates with his captain, they wanted that wicket dearly
dabbed to short third man
almost in the blockhole on the stumps, but Bravo has dealt with it so well, he has allowed the tossed up ball to come on, opened the face and driven it through point,  beats a diving sweeper cover
tries to slog the full delivery out of sight, mistimes it completely to midwicket
starts off with one turning down leg, Raina sweeps it to deep square
worked behind square leg
superb placement, it was tossed up on leg, he got front foot out of the way and lifted it over midwicket, two men in the deep there, both had no chance
steps out and whips it along the ground past Harbhajan to long on
pushed straight to extra cover
worked away to deep midwicket
hit on the pad as he misses the work on the leg side, not given
another one, inside out now, all flourish, as he lofts it with a big followthrough to the deep extra cover boundary
powerful, Bravo finds the straight boundary, front foot goes out, and he swings the full delivery from off over the non-striker
this time he succeeds in lofting the ball over extra cover, sweeper cover is in place

that has gone for four, I don't know how, not sure even Raina knows, he seemed to be trying to drive this pitched up ball through the off side, but instead sent it to the deep midwicket boundary off the inside part of the bat
eagerly flicks a full delivery off the pads to deep square leg
pushes from the crease but is late on the shot and mistimes it to extra cover
worked in front of square leg
pulled away to deep midwicket
length ball carries down the leg side
plays late to a similar one and manages to push it to long off

lovely delivery, flighted and carrying with the angle past the right-hander, Bravo walked forward as he pushed inside the line, there was a sound as the ball passed Bravo, but Karthik could not hold on anyway
fullish one played down the pitch
makes some room and punches from around off to sweeper cover
slides just down the leg side from around the stumps
poor line from Franklin, a nudge is all that is required off the pads to send the ball fine past a diving keeper
Vijay is gone, he struggled to get the ball away today, tried to whip this pitched up ball over mid on, but Harbhajan went back just outside the circle to take an easy catch
pushed towards point
makes a mile worth of room outside leg, but cannot guide this one past point, whose dive prevents the boundary
tucks a full one off the pad to deep midwicket
short ball sitting up, languidly pulled away to deep midwicket
full, quick, and on the pads, he tucks it towards square leg, and sets off, but is sent back in time
works away a shortish ball to deep midwicket
that was just out of mid on's reach, Raina came forward to push and got it off the inner part of the bat, in the air, but mid on could not get to it, deep midwicket cuts it off
quickish one darted across the right-hander, thick edge goes to short third
drives a full delivery to long off
succeeds this time, did not try to murder the ball, just went through with the horizontal shot from the crease and got it just over mid on
he puts front foot out and tries to swing this shortish delivery out of sight from outside off, beaten
backs away and squeezes out a run to third man
he abandons the slog, and connects superbly this time, makes a bit of room to a pitched up ball on off, and sends it soaring over mid off with a graceful loft, different batsmen on display suddenly
he plays the shot again, manages to connect, off the inside part of the bat, through square leg
Raina tried to play that slog-swat of his over midwicket, the delivery was in the slot for him, just back of a length on the stumps, but he misses
he hops about in the crease, expecting the short ball into him, oh well, it is short, not that much, but outside off, he adjusts and guides it to third man even as he is jumping in the air
big appeal for caught behind, Karthik is celebrating, Malinga is jumping, Raina missed the nudge to a shortish one dug into to him, umpire Taufel signals wide, Malinga has his hands on his knees
he gets a single this time, with a push just wide of mid off
pushes towards cover and charges out for the single, is sent back, the fielder had got to the ball already
the slower one now, full and just outside off at 124.9 kph, Vijay pushes it out
stays back in the crease and plays out a straightish length ball around off to point
whoa, this outfield it fast, that was just a push from Raina, but it almost ran into the deep extra cover boundary, and needed a dive from the chasing fielder to pull it back in
excellent timing, not much wrong with the ball, slight width as it rises outside off, Raina guides it past point and it needs a dive from Malinga at third man to save the boundary
he is away now, back of a length ball whipped off the pads to deep midwicket
can;t get off the mark yet, pushes a bouncing length ball towards covers
tentatively plays out a fullish one to mid on, he is looking a bit jittery
driven towards extra cover
wide, length ball goes down the leg side with the angle
starts off with a widish back of a length ball, slashed away to third man
widish one dabbed towards third man
he is greeted by that yorker, it zooms in for the stumps, or the legs, Raina somehow gets bat down on it, just about, middle would have been uprooted otherwise
a direct hit in the first over, it is Ambati Rayudu running in from extra cover as the batsmen attempt a tight single, a one-handed pick-up and lob finds a diving Faf well short of his crease
a defensive push forward and the length ball races to cover
similar delivery, shade fuller,  Faf manages to get bat around pad and tuck it through midwicket, the crowd goes ballistic
right on target, length ball, bounces on Faf, he gets behind the line, defends
starts with a full and wide one screaming down the leg side
Rayudu ends it with a six over the third man boundary, leans back and opens the face to guide it superbly over the rope, it wasn't far from the fielder there, but too quick for him
chopped away to sweeper cover
played out to midwicket from the crease
MI finally get a move-on after the time-out, Franklin lofts a pitched up ball over midwicket
pushed off the front foot to mid on, non-striker had set off but got back
chops it down to sweeper cover
carries straightish down leg
beaten as he tries to run an angled ball to third man
slaps a wide ball away to sweeper cover
defended towards cover off the front foot
pulls swiftly down to fine leg on the bounce
short ball takes off, Franklin allows it to go past him after initially looking to play it
drives it down to long off
pulled away to deep midwicket
worked to deep square leg
drives to extra cover
blocks one bowled in fullish on middle and leg
guided from the crease to sweeper cover
full delivery flicked through square leg
bounce outside off, Rayudu looks to cut and is beaten
easily done, allows a length ball to come on around middle and leg, drops it on to the off side softly for one more
comes down the track and hits the length ball wide of sweeper cover, they settle for one
good delivery, quick and on off with the angle, defended on to the leg side
slightly short, pulled away to deep square leg
forced down to long on
pushed in front of point, who misfields, and concedes the second
blocked off the front foot
stays in the crease to a flighted delivery, allows it to turn away, and runs it to short third
length ball dabbed softly in front of point for one more
drives a tossed up ball down to long off
pushed in the air down to long off
driven behind point who takes pace off it with a dive
Albie has bowled some terrific deliveries today, here's another one, angled in, pitches around off on a length and zips away from the right-hander, who is left pushing in the air
pushed wide of cover for an easy single
that has gone through him, angled across just outside off, hint of inward shape as he ends up wafting outside the line
thick outside edge towards backward point
pushed down to long on
stays back to a length ball hurrying towards middle, dabs it in front of cover for a quick single, there is a direct hit but Rayudu is home
full delivery driven down to long off
good response from Franklin, he comes forward to one that offers him some width and drives it hard past cover
beats him with one that holds its line outside off
worked away to deep square leg
played out towards covers
he was surprised by this short delivery, he was initially looking to duck, but it did not get up that much, was headed for his chest, he ended up swatting it away in the end
pushed off the back foot in front of cover for a single
rides the bounce and chops it to sweeper cover
beaten first up by a skiddy length delivery outside off
tucked through square leg off the pad
serious bounce on that one, takes Sachin by surprise, he somehow manages to fend it down
dabbed away to third man

and after taking so much time to be ready for the next ball, Rohit is gone now, Bollinger digging it in short, Rohit was not sure whether to play at it, ended up pushing tamely at it, Dhoni takes it low, but safely, umpire Taufel checks with the square leg umpire about the catch and sends Rohit back
Rohit misses the work on the leg side as this length ball bounces, he seems to be in some pain as he takes in on the body, he's taken it right on the box, that is why
high full toss outside off, Sachin adjusts and guides it away, point saves the boundary with a dive
leading edge towards the bowler as he looks to work on the leg side
gone this time, reaches out to a widish and full one outside off, and swats it straight to long off
Levi gets to 50 in his first IPL innings with a six over wide long on, takes it from outside off and flicks it, one leg in the air as he plays the shot
played out to point
full on the pads, turned wide of fine leg for two more
tries to launch this one with the angle over square leg, but cannot connect, it rolls towards the keeper
straigtish length ball dabbed through point
that will go, tossed up offbreak slog-swept from outside off stump over deep midwicket
worked to midwicket
hits hard down the track but Ashwin stops it low to his right
pushes a length ball back to the bowler
the line has been leg stump for a while, nudged fine and wide of short fine
Jadeja is leaking runs right away, sprays it down the pads and gets tickled fine for four more
shout for lbw, but that was going down leg stump
top-edges it fine down the leg side as he tries to paddle a length ball that bounces
hit hard down to long on
nothing top-edged about this one, picks it up and slog-sweeps it way over deep midwicket
massive top-edge of a sweep, short fine is in place, it goes one bounce into the fine leg boundary
full delivery flicked to square leg
gets the sweep away this time to fine leg
pushes a shortish one back to the bowler
goes for the sweep but misses and is hit on the pad
length ball worked past a diving square leg
leading edge rolls towards mid off, Levi was looking to turn it on the leg side
bowler responds with a stinging bouncer, brushes the helmet on its way towards Dhoni
clobber, he's lifted that full delivery from outside off and crashed it over mid on
vintage Tendulkar, a shuffle, an eager flourish of a flick and he watches the ball race through square leg
pushed wide of covers for a tight single, throw misses at the non-striker;s
he seems to be happy to go for the pull often, misses the shortish one into him though
too full, too much on the pads, flicked away easily to the deep square leg rope
punched to covers
what a corker of a reply from Morkel, angled in and zipping away from Sachin, no way of playing that, lucky not to edge it, or get bowled, that wasn't far from the stumps

that has gone all the way, some stroke that, down the track, the ball was going away from him, he reached out and lofted it without fuss, it went comfortably over the deep extra cover boundary, Sachin holds the followthrough for effect
phew, that is a jaffa, hurled in with the angle, and takes off from a good length, bounce and away movement, Sachin is beaten completely
crack! Sachin goes through the packed off side infield, stays in the crease and punches it through extra cover
not in control of the pull but gets it away square to the man in the deep
takes a step out and allows a length ball to go past with the angle
worked to deep midwicket for a single
misses the hit square on the leg side as this one moves in down leg
slightly short, and this time he connects finally, pulls it hard and Bavo's superb diving effort at deep midwicket is in vain, he gets to the ball but it rolls away to the rope in the end
tries to smash it over mid on, but misses the pitched up delivery
hit on the pad as he misses the attempted swing on the leg side
he somehow manages to squeeze it between cover and point, wasn't looking to go through that region as Doug bowled it full outside off
he is getting it to shape away neatly but it starts too far outside off this time, and is left alone
pushes hard from the crease, extra cover dives, but cannot prevent a single
tries to pull from way outside off, but mistimes it off the toe end towards slip
pushed away towards cover
again away shape from a good length, left alone this time
sharp away shape and bounce for Morkel first up, Levi tried to push at it initially but then withdrew his bat
